glosses: cupboard (cabinet, often built into a wall, with shelves intended for storage)
wardrobe, closet (cupboard or cabinet designed for storing clothes)
bookcase (piece of furniture for the storage and display of books)

examples.text: Hast du in den Schrank gesehen?
examples.en: Did you look in the cupboard?

examples.text: Öffne den Schrank mit diesem Schlüssel hier.
examples.en: Open the cabinet with this key.

examples.text: Das habe ich hinten im Schrank gefunden.
examples.en: I found that in the back of the closet.
